mintAuthority.summary: EURSAFO is an AMF-authorized UCITS fund share. At Ethereum block 26095799, PermissionManager authorizes Minter proxy 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366 to mint EURSAFO. Its ordinary daily limit is 5,000,000 shares, but the 3-of-6 super-admin Safe can raise the limit, approve pending over-limit mints and upgrade the token, Minter and PermissionManager. The previously recorded two relayers are EUTBL/USTBL token proxies, not current EURSAFO minters; remaining operator rosters require review.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095799, the formerly recorded relayers were identified as other fund-token proxies, not EURSAFO minters. Round-2 recovery of PermissionManager GroupAdded and GroupRemoved logs from deployment through block 26098764 succeeded using the filtered Blockscout logs API. Current getGroups reads confirm one group-0 super-admin Safe, six group-2 contract principals, seven group-9 approvers and two group-10 initiators. Five group-2 contracts return other fund tokens from getToken(); the sixth is the known Minter. The Ethereum initiator/approver roster is now documented in the Minter evidence. Remaining non-Ethereum operator rosters and exact principal-to-key-custody mappings remain unresolved; the issuer documents Dfns-managed relayer signing without identifying these addresses.

controls.label: EURSAFO Ethereum Minter proxy
controls.capDescription: At Ethereum block 26095799, dailyLimit(EURSAFO) is 500000000000 raw, or 5,000,000 five-decimal shares; getMintedToday(EURSAFO) is zero. Exceeding the ordinary limit creates a pending mint. A privileged approveMint call can execute that pending mint without applying the daily-limit check, and the super-admin Safe can change dailyLimit immediately. maxDelay() = 86400 is the pending-operation expiry window, not an enforced approval delay or immutable economic ceiling.
controls.evidence: The block-26095799 implementation and limit review established Minter 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366, ordinary dailyLimit(EURSAFO) = 500000000000 raw, maxDelay = 86400 and discretionary over-limit approval. At block 26098764, the same limit and expiry were re-read. getRequirements(Minter, initiateMint selector 0x7fa62fcc) = 0x401, so group 10 or admin can initiate; approveMint selector 0x442dbf77 = 0x201, so group 9 or admin can approve. This corrects the previously reversed group labels. Complete indexed GroupAdded/GroupRemoved history plus current getGroups reads identify group-10 initiators 0x7a493c05479f6132cb895c72c49439139b595eb4 and 0xe582cddcb3d2374adbb34c9afe76683d019c8a2b, both with empty eth_getCode. Group-9 approvers are 0x4896f23ff83242d8d4eb5fa1dedf8c57e9145949, 0x4d1d9c5b5d9ca448194313d799de374f362bd460, 0x6ca0aa6d3bf500d65f6e17a27af05c74ed4bfb5a, 0xd9dbe8ea915131d821279a0eb51bec0fd8affbe7, 0xda47bd72438f11bef7cc54f18cd02426dd86a5a2, 0xe67d2cbeae3090be017c66e7a6943961619a5d35 and 0xf949ca7be175a5fcbd3febb9a0235de608ca7898. All approvers except 0xd9dbe8ea915131d821279a0eb51bec0fd8affbe7 have empty code; that address has contract code. The sole group-0 principal is the previously reviewed 3-of-6 Safe. The cap remains bypassable by approval and raiseable by admin; this roster does not establish an immutable economic ceiling or the custody of any individual signing key.

review.evidence: The earlier pinned implementation, 3-of-6 Safe, raiseable daily limit, discretionary over-limit approval and lack of enforced approval timelock remain confirmed. Round-2 indexed role-history recovery and current reads at Ethereum block 26098764 resolve the seven group-9 approvers and two group-10 initiators and correct their previously reversed labels. Ethereum mint requirements are group 0 or group 2; all current group-2 principals were identified, including the Minter and five contracts whose getToken() values name other funds. Complete non-Ethereum operator rosters and exact key-custody mappings remain open. CACEIS daily valuation and Chainlink's exact EURSAFO NAV feed are now verified separately in oracleRisk. PwC appointment and AMF authorization remain separate from a current financial assurance report.

scopedQuestions.question: Which principals control native EURSAFO minting on each non-Ethereum deployment, and which exact current signing addresses are covered by Dfns-managed custody or other documented key protections? Ethereum PermissionManager groups 0, 2, 9 and 10 were recovered from complete filtered event history and current reads at block 26098764. Group 10 initiates and group 9 approves the Minter's pending operations; those rosters are no longer unknown. The reach of the five other-token group-2 contracts must remain token-bound in any cross-fund capability analysis.
